description: An ADE class written through adeSchemas: a GeoJSON polygon typed uro:UndergroundBuilding, with i-UR 3.1 listed from the PLATEAU fixture's own urbanObject.xsd. The writer must emit uro:UndergroundBuilding rather than a building or a generic object, name its geometry property in the bldg namespace it inherits from, and declare the uro namespace with the public schema location. The case ships a validation.xsd so check-citygml-schema validates it against i-UR too. New-world only, as for attribute_keys: the LOD is read from an attribute.
